title.narrative: Initiativ för att omforma maskulinitet och främja jämställdhet
The Catalyst Initiative: Transforming Masculinity, Accelerating Equality

description.narrative:
1. Deconstruction of dominant norms and increased self-awareness
Participants will critically deconstruct dominant, harmful masculine norms, recognize their impact, and demonstrate heightened awareness of how these norms have shaped their own identities, beliefs, and professional and personal behaviours.
2. Internalization of positive masculinity principles
Participants will internalize and articulate a framework of positive masculinity rooted in empathy, accountability, and shared power, equipping them to actively apply these principles over conditioned responses.
3. Active promotion of gender-transformative environments and programming
Participants will act as agents of change by modeling positive masculinity and practicing active allyship, demonstrably contributing to safer, more equitable, and collaborative work environments as well as more strategic and deliberate gender transformative programming.
